definitions.explanation: The act of publishing and distributing printed works such as books or periodicals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刊行|かんこう}する。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{刊行|かんこう}された。
⟦{全集|ぜんしゅう}→全集：11783_zenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{刊行|かんこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧するまで、あと2⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧かかる⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It is expected to take two more years until the publication of the complete works is finished.

notes:
{刊行|かんこう} is a formal term for publishing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{刊行|かんこう}する

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {刊行|かんこう}する (to publish)
- {刊行|かんこう}される (to be published)
- {刊行|かんこう}⟦{物|ぶつ}→物：noentry⟧ (publication, published work)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刊行|かんこう}: publication (formal, books)
- ⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧: publishing (general)
- ⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧: issue, publication (periodicals, documents)

NOTE: {刊行|かんこう} is often used for books and formal publications, while ⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ is broader.
